decision.reason: The single isolated prompt clarification did not improve the two reported three-column goals. No corpus rewrite, fallback, output repair or new weights.
decision.guard: After existing strict validation, require the output column set to equal all explicitly selected task columns. Omitted selected columns reject the whole proposal.

decision.userScopeGuidance: Select only columns to process; set unneeded columns to Ignore. Existing catalog labels: İşlenecek sütun / Yoksay. No UI files or catalog entries changed.
decision.limitations: Column coverage is not verification of goal semantics or operation completeness within a column. An output can still use the wrong supported operation, omit an operation within a covered column, or substitute supported operations for an unsupported action. Mandatory preview remains necessary.
decision.negativeDisposition: Mixed translation output was rejected for omitted C3, not an explicit neural unsupported refusal. Do not count this as successful semantic recognition.
decision.backendBoundary: Actual tests used native onnxruntime-node CPU, two inference threads, one inter-op thread and serial generation. No new browser/WASM validation was performed.
